customCards.name: Ruinwatch Custodian
customCards.renderedText:
▸Dissolved: Choose another character in your void to gain reclaim 2●.

Reclaim 2●.

customDreamsigns.name: Passage Lantern
customDreamsigns.effectDescription: The first time each turn you rematerialize a character, it gains +1✦.

encounters.prose: A child raises a round lantern before a narrow window of stars.

action.label: Exchange Familiar Forms
action.effectText: Purge a chosen card and gain a copy of another chosen card
action.responseText: One silhouette recedes as another emerges beside its double.

action.label: Request the Round Lantern
action.effectText: Gain Passage Lantern. The first time each turn you rematerialize a character, it gains +1✦.
action.responseText: The child lowers its steady glow into your hands.

encounters.prose: Before you, an armored sentinel rests beside a fractured doorway glowing amid ruins.

action.label: Invite the Sentinel
action.effectText: Gain Ruinwatch Custodian (2● Survivor Character, 2✦ — ▸Dissolved: Choose another character in your void to gain reclaim 2●. Reclaim 2●.)
action.responseText: The guardian rises and walks beside you.

action.label: Study the Guardian
action.effectText: Apply a transfiguration to 2 chosen Survivor cards
action.responseText: Your companions adopt its measured discipline among the ruins.

encounters.prose: Before you, a colossal wolf advances through burning grass, pale eyes fixed ahead.

action.label: Feed the Fire
action.responseText: The blaze consumes what you cast away.

action.label: Welcome Its Kin
action.effectText: Choose one of 2 packs of Spirit Animal cards to add to your deck
action.responseText: Other wolves emerge through the heated haze.

encounters.prose: Before you, a skull-faced colossus lowers a radiant lantern toward a child.

action.label: Invite a Lantern Visitor
action.effectText: Gain an offered ≤2● cost Character card
action.responseText: A new figure steps from between the panes.

action.label: Trade Away a Figure
action.effectText: Purge a chosen card and gain 40 essence for each ✦ it had
action.responseText: A skeletal hand accepts the chosen offering.

encounters.prose: A luminous triangle encloses an armed figure as black cables stream outward.

action.label: Enter the Luminous Frame
action.effectText: Change a chosen Character card to have Outsider
action.responseText: Its bright outline alters one waiting silhouette.

action.label: Expand the Luminous Frame
action.effectText: All characters in your deck become the subtype of your choice.
action.responseText: The widening glow reshapes every distant silhouette.

encounters.prose: Beside a silent figure, an immense owl stares through drifting motes.

action.label: Ask the Figure's Counsel
action.effectText: Draft a ≤2● cost Character card from 4 random choices
action.responseText: The smaller figure indicates several shapes in the haze.

action.label: Welcome the Owl's Kin
action.effectText: Take any number of Spirit Animal cards from 4 random choices
action.responseText: Calls answer as animal forms settle among the branches.

encounters.prose: A whale’s shadowed bulk crosses the stars above your small craft.

action.label: Welcome a Smaller Swimmer
action.responseText: A bright new shape circles beneath the giant.

action.label: Release a Fellow Swimmer
action.effectText: Purge a chosen Spirit Animal card and gain a random Spirit Animal replacement
action.responseText: Another broad silhouette rises into the open sky.

encounters.prose: An enormous elephant emerges from starlit mist, its curved tusks shining.

action.label: Welcome the Great Beast
action.effectText: Gain 1 "Nightmare" bane card. Gain Emerald Guardian.
action.responseText: The elephant kneels as the surrounding haze darkens.

action.label: Call the Distant Herd
action.effectText: Gain one copy of each of 2 random Spirit Animal cards
action.responseText: Great animal shapes approach through the radiant mist.

encounters.prose: Above you, a colossal horseman thins into drifting starlight.

action.label: Call Into the Distance
action.responseText: A clear bell tolls beneath the distant horse.

action.label: Gather the Falling Light
action.effectText: Apply Kindled to a chosen ≤2● cost Character card from your deck
action.responseText: A waiting traveler's outline shines with renewed strength.
